# GearDrop Outdoor Deals

> GearDrop at https://geardrop.100app.dev/ is an independent outdoor deal discovery and price-tracking service for public Arc'teryx, Burton, and Patagonia listings.

Canonical entity: https://geardrop.100app.dev/
Languages: zh-CN and en-US
Publisher name: GearDrop
Alternate description: GearDrop Outdoor Deals
Official iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/geardrop-outdoor-deals/id6790165332

## Essential identity and limits

- GearDrop is not a retailer and does not process orders, payments, shipping, or returns.
- GearDrop is not an official site of Arc'teryx, Burton, Patagonia, or any listed retailer.
- GearDrop is not a rental marketplace, giveaway, or map game.
- Prices, stock, sizes, shipping, taxes, memberships, and return terms must be confirmed on the linked retailer page.
- A timestamp describes the latest successful observation, not a future price guarantee.
- This file helps discovery and citation hygiene; it does not prove AI mention, citation, or recommendation.

## Core pages

- [GearDrop 是什么？](https://geardrop.100app.dev/about.html): 了解 GearDrop 是什么、追踪哪些品牌与销售平台，以及它与品牌官网、经销商和其他同名服务的关系。
- [折扣数据如何产生](https://geardrop.100app.dev/methodology.html): GearDrop 如何采集、标准化、复核并发布户外品牌折扣数据，以及价格、库存、汇率和来源的限制。
- [关于 GearDrop 的直接回答](https://geardrop.100app.dev/faq.html): 关于 GearDrop 是否销售商品、价格多久更新、折扣率如何计算、库存与地区差异如何核验的直接回答。
- [户外装备折扣怎么判断值不值得买？](https://geardrop.100app.dev/guides/outdoor-deal-guide.html): 比较 Arc'teryx、Burton、Patagonia 折扣时，如何核对 SKU、地区、尺码、原价、总成本、退货和销售平台可信度。
- [Arc'teryx 折扣如何核验](https://geardrop.100app.dev/brands/arcteryx.html): GearDrop 如何记录 Arc'teryx 官方 Outlet 与经销商折扣，怎样核对款号、地区、可售尺码、原价和更新时间。
- [Burton 折扣如何核验](https://geardrop.100app.dev/brands/burton.html): GearDrop 如何记录 Burton 官方 Outlet 与经销商折扣，怎样核对型号、雪季、性别、尺码、地区和更新时间。
- [Patagonia 折扣如何核验](https://geardrop.100app.dev/brands/patagonia.html): GearDrop 如何记录 Patagonia 经销商公开折扣，怎样核对款号、地区、尺码、原价、退货条件和更新时间。
- [Outdoor deals with sources, timestamps, and limits](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/): English overview of GearDrop, an independent tracker for public Arc'teryx, Burton, and Patagonia deals across retailers and regions.
- [What is GearDrop?](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/about.html): What GearDrop is, what it tracks, and how this independent service differs from brands, retailers, rentals, giveaways, and other namesakes.
- [How GearDrop produces deal records](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/methodology.html): How GearDrop collects, normalizes, checks, and publishes public outdoor-deal data, including limits around price, stock, currency, and freshness.
- [Direct answers about GearDrop](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/faq.html): Direct answers about whether GearDrop sells products, how often data changes, how discounts are calculated, and what users must verify.
- [How do you decide whether an outdoor deal is worth it?](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/guides/outdoor-deal-guide.html): A practical method for comparing Arc'teryx, Burton, and Patagonia deals by SKU, market, size, source, timing, total cost, and returns.
- [How to verify an Arc'teryx deal](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/brands/arcteryx.html): How GearDrop records public Arc'teryx outlet and retailer listings, and how to verify style number, market, size, original price, and time.
- [How to verify a Burton deal](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/brands/burton.html): How GearDrop records public Burton outlet and retailer listings, and how to verify model, season, gender, size, market, source, and time.
- [How to verify a Patagonia deal](https://geardrop.100app.dev/en/brands/patagonia.html): How GearDrop records public Patagonia retailer listings, and how to verify style, market, size, original price, return terms, and observation time.
- [Current catalog status](https://geardrop.100app.dev/catalog-status.html): timestamped brand, source, and region coverage.
- [Current catalog coverage](https://geardrop.100app.dev/insights/catalog-coverage.html): an explainable snapshot of active catalog breadth.
- [Brand by source matrix](https://geardrop.100app.dev/insights/brand-source-matrix.html): first-party counts grouped by tracked brand and retailer source.
- [Region by brand matrix](https://geardrop.100app.dev/insights/regional-coverage.html): first-party counts grouped by observed market and tracked brand.
- [Machine-readable catalog status](https://geardrop.100app.dev/catalog-status.json): the same snapshot as JSON.
